SELECT h.purchase_request_id AS purchaseRequestId, d.purchase_request_detail_id AS purchaseRequestDetailId, h.request_no AS requestNo, h.request_dt AS requestDt, ru.user_nm AS requesterName, dept.department_nm AS requestDeptName, h.status AS status, h.remark AS remark, d.line_no AS lineNo, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, d.request_qty AS requestQty, d.request_delivery_dt AS requestDeliveryDt, d.use_type AS useType, ci.item_nm AS useTypeName, d.request_remark AS requestRemark, d.confirm_qty AS confirmQty FROM tb_purchase_request_hd h JOIN tb_purchase_request_dt d ON d.purchase_request_id = h.purchase_request_id AND d.tenant_id = h.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.user_id = h.requester_id LEFT JOIN tb_department dept ON dept.department_id = h.request_dept_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = d.material_id AND m.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group cg ON cg.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND cg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_USE_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item ci ON ci.group_id = cg.common_code_group_id AND ci.item_code = d.use_type WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.use_at = 'Y'
AND (h.request_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR ru.user_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND h.request_no ILIKE '%' || #{requestNo} || '%'
AND ru.user_nm ILIKE '%' || #{requesterKeyword} || '%'
AND h.status = #{status}
AND (m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%')
AND d.use_type = #{useType}
AND h.request_dt >= CAST(#{requestDtFrom} AS date)
AND h.request_dt <= CAST(#{requestDtTo} AS date)
AND d.request_delivery_dt >= CAST(#{requestDeliveryDtFrom} AS date)
AND d.request_delivery_dt <= CAST(#{requestDeliveryDtTo} AS date)
ORDER BY h.request_dt DESC, h.request_no DESC, d.line_no
